children: Creative Medical Technology Holdings reported no revenue in 3Q 2026, compared with no revenue a year earlier. Its attributable loss widened as research and development spending increased, primarily due to stock-based expense associated with the BioDefense investment and higher development spending on other platforms; lower ADAPT trial costs partly offset the increase.
¹ Reported as “Revenues”. ² Reported as “NET LOSS ATTRIBUTABLE TO CMTH”. ³ Reported as “NET LOSS PER SHARE - BASIC AND DILUTED”.
: Quarterly expense rose 244% to $1.6M, driven primarily by $1.17M in BioDefense-related stock-based expense and higher spending on other platforms.
: Costs fell $150,601 as the CELZ-201 lower-back-pain trial moved from recruitment and dosing to follow-up.
: Quarterly expense increased 43% to $1.1M, including higher compensation and legal fees, partly offset by lower marketing.
: The FDA-cleared ADAPT Phase 1/2 trial has Fast Track designation; an expanded cohort for patients using less than 90 mg per day in morphine equivalents was cleared in June.
